title: hermes-doctor output schema
description: Output contract for `hermes-doctor.py --json`. Versioned alongside scripts/hermes-doctor.py via the schema_version field. Includes Phase A's CANNOT_LOCATE verdict, exit code 3, and the plugin_root_source / plugin_root_note fields; Phase B's drift stratifications, cache_state, and the banner-rendering approximate caveat.

$schema.description: URL of this schema; consumers fetch to validate.

schema_version.description: Semver. Bumped whenever the output shape changes in a consumer-visible way.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project being checked.

plugin_root.description: Resolved plugin root, or null when CANNOT_LOCATE.

plugin_root_source.description: Which step of the root-resolution cascade produced plugin_root. 'not-found' implies plugin_root is null and verdict is CANNOT_LOCATE.

plugin_root_note.description: Human-readable diagnostic about plugin_root resolution. Non-null when the cascade fell through a step (e.g. env was set but invalid).

layer1.description: Layer 1 (plugin) check results. Empty array when CANNOT_LOCATE (root not resolvable, checks skipped).

layer2.description: Layer 2 (project state) check results including format, intake_reconciliation, banner_rendering.

drift.description: Stratified drift report (E-1). Two stratifications carried as separate keys; low-volume drift aggregated only (brief explicitly excludes those from segmentation).

format_violations_by_file_and_domain.description: One entry per backlog file with at least one §3.2 violation.

violations_grandfathered.description: Per §3.2 line 644, missing-Standard items are grandfathered for one transition cycle. Bucketed separately so consumers can prioritise.

banner_misses_by_source.description: Approximate — measures SessionStart hook success/timeout per matcher source (startup/resume/clear/compact/unknown), NOT model render verification.

intake_reconciliation_unmatched.description: C-1: backlog events in usage.log without a matching intake_step. Quiet (empty) until intake actually flows (Session D).

low_volume_aggregate.description: Aggregate counts of low-volume drift events from usage.log. Brief explicitly excludes these from arbitrary stratification.

cache_state.description: Layer-2 cache state per §2.7. The cache is a freshness-checked read (mtime match), never a TTL guess. null when cache module unavailable.

verdict.description: Distinct verdicts. CANNOT_LOCATE is structurally different from BROKEN: 'I can't find Layer 1' is not 'Layer 1 is broken.'

exit_code.description:
Exit code contract — CI consumers must key on all four. Treating only exit 2 as failure mis-handles CANNOT_LOCATE.
  0 HEALTHY
  1 DEGRADED (advisories present, no failures)
  2 BROKEN (root resolved AND checks failed)
  3 CANNOT_LOCATE (root could not be located; checks were not run against Layer 1)
